task.title: Using USB Flash Drive Mode (Audio Inputs)
task.shortdesc: Using USB Flash Mode allows you to play downloaded music through a thumb drive in your car without needing to use a mobile device. The transmitter will read the music files and broadcast them over your car's radio

context.p: To use this mode, you will need to ensure you go through the set-up of the transmitter in your car. Once done, you can quickly begin the steps on using this input option.

step.cmd: Locate the USB Flash Drive Port on your FM Transmitter. ="image of transmitter with USB Flash Drive Port labeled"

step.note: If the transmitter stays in the default mode (Bluetooth), short press the Mode Switch Button once to switch to USB Flash Drive Mode.
step.cmd: Plug in your USB thumb drive (loaded with supported formats) and plug into the music port. ="Image of thumb drive plugged into FM Transmitter."
step.stepresult: The transmitter should automatically detect the drive and begin playing music files.

step.cmd: Use the Multi-Function Button music playing features to control music playback on the drive.
step.info: See the table, for details on the Multi-Function-Button's music-playing features

taskbody.result: You are now successfully using USB Flash Drive Mode and can listen to your downloaded music in your car.
